title: Brightwater Industries: m and a review (fictional)

documents.title: Information memorandum
documents.text:
Information memorandum — Brightwater Industries (fictional).
In this document "BIH" means Brightwater Industries. Brightwater Industries reports normalised net working capital of $23.7m for FY2024 on a reported basis. Brightwater Industries reports annual customer churn of 3.307% for FY2024. Brightwater Industries reports headcount of 257.514 for FY2025. Brightwater Industries reports enterprise value of $816.5m for FY2025 on a reported basis under the original agreement.

documents.title: Financial due diligence report
documents.text:
Financial due diligence report — Brightwater Industries (fictional).
Brightwater Industries reports normalised net working capital of $27.5m for FY2025 on a reported basis. Brightwater Industries reports annual customer churn of 3.3% for FY2024. Brightwater Industries reports gross margin of 43.8% for FY2024. BIH reports earn out of $46.5m for FY2024 on a reported basis.

documents.title: Draft share purchase agreement
documents.text:
Draft share purchase agreement — Brightwater Industries (fictional).
Brightwater Industries reports headcount of 257 for FY2025. Brightwater Industries reports enterprise value of $677.8m for FY2025 on a reported basis under the amendment no. 1 (supersedes). Brightwater Logistics subsidiary reports gross margin of 39.7% for FY2024. Brightwater Industries reports earn out of $42.7m for FY2024 on a reported basis.
